source: make a fun 3d shooter game where you czn unlock different weapons. make about 15 different weapons. Make skin boxes you czn opento get skins for different weapons and wrap boxes where you get cool textures (wraps) to apply to your guns. also make a lobby and matchmaking, a practice arena and dofferent gammodes

image_prompt.text: Waist-high and full-body cover distributed evenly across every lane of the combat map
Narrow transitions where the lanes meet, concentrating fights onto contested ground
Balanced bases at opposite ends of the map, shielded from enemy sniper lines
A lobby hub where players gather between matches, with weapon and skin display stands
A practice arena: an open shooting range with targets and obstacles for testing the unlocked weapons

layout_placement.text: Team spawn volumes at opposite ends, out of each other's sightlines

notes: The prompt asks for four kinds of space - a lobby, a practice arena, several game-mode arenas, and the combat map itself. This handoff describes the combat map; the lobby and range are carried as null-id entries because Shooter has no option for either.
Different game modes means different maps: Team Deathmatch was chosen as the default because no mode was named.
Skin boxes and wrap boxes read as an unlock economy rather than geometry; only place them as physical crates if the lobby is the build.

open_questions.ask: No setting was given - should the maps be modern military, sci-fi, or bright and cartoonish?
Which space should be built first: the lobby, the practice range, or a match map?
Which game modes do you want - team deathmatch, free-for-all, objective modes?

coverage_missing.ask: What setting and art style should the maps have?
Which of the four spaces should be built first?
What are the different game modes?

answers.ask: No setting was given - should the maps be modern military, sci-fi, or bright and cartoonish?
answers.answer: Use a bright, cartoonish shooter style so the weapons, skins, and wraps feel fun and readable.

answers.ask: Which space should be built first: the lobby, the practice range, or a match map?
answers.answer: Build the lobby first, since it is the hub for matchmaking, weapon unlocks, skin boxes, wrap boxes, and entering the practice arena.

answers.ask: Which game modes do you want - team deathmatch, free-for-all, objective modes?
answers.answer: Include team deathmatch and free-for-all first; keep objective modes out of the initial build.
